Department of Physics
Study with us!
Welcome to the Department of Physics!
Our research is leading nationally and has high international status. We offer undergraduate and advanced level programs where you will be part of small student groups. Our researchers will be your teachers. After graduating with a degree in physics, you will have broad expertise and will be ready for employment. You can work as a medical physicist, quantum analyst, cryptologist, risk analyst, statistician or software developer, and in a variety of other professions.
Welcome to study physics at Fysikum!
The application period is 15th September - 15th October for Spring 2027. Search among our courses and programmes.
Collaborative effort to develop cancer treatment
Stockholm University, KI, KTH and Region Stockholm intend to establish a new centre for medical radiation science in Stockholm.
Fysikum has been granted 50,6 million for research
Eleven researchers at Fysikum have been awarded project grants, and one has received an establishment grant.

Our courses and programmes
The Department of Physics offers bachelor's degree programs in physics and four master's programs.
We also offer individual courses, evening courses, and distance learning courses.

Our research
At Fysikum, we conduct research in projects involving theoretical and experimental physics within seven different subject areas of physics. We collaborate with various departments and other universities.

Cooperation and Collaboration
Fysikum organizes events for schools and the general public, such as the Physics Competition and Physics Show, and we participate in Research Friday.
Work with us
Welcome to work with us at Fysikum. Our researchers are teachers. We also have technical and administrative staff.
Discrimination and harassment
The Department of Physics shall be characterized by a safe, stimulating, and sustainable working environment. Here you can read more about this and equal opportunities.
